name: Sabeans
overview: The Sabeans appear in Scripture as a distinct people involved in both conflict and commerce. They are noted for their raid upon the land of Uz, where they violently seized servants (Job 1:15), and are described as men of stature who will come in submission, recognizing the one true God (Isaiah 45:14). Prophetic passages also indicate their role in God's sovereign plans, including being a distant people to whom captives will be sold (Joel 3:8). Additionally, Ezekiel portrays the Sabeans as associated with a proverbial image of drunkenness, highlighting a cultural characteristic known to the ancient audience (Ezekiel 23:42).
